fact: UNHCR states around 185,000 refugees were registered in the national population registry by December 2025.
UNHCR states it supported ANRPTS in mobile registration of refugees in remote Hodh Chargui locations to address the registration backlog and speed issuance of National Identification Numbers (NNIs).
UNHCR states 109,000 Malian refugees are registered in Hodh Chargui and 19,000 refugees and asylum-seekers are registered in urban areas, 128,000 in all.
UNHCR states refugees in the camp have access to financial products including bank accounts.
UNHCR states the number of refugees in the camp with access to financial products, including bank accounts, rose from 2,400 in 2022 to 5,600 in 2023.
